div.p: The text has been updated, following the discovery of two new, small fragments during work for the APIS project. One was stuck on the back of the papyrus itself, and brings a few letters to the left of lines 15-17. The other is P.Mich. inv. nr. 5838c, from another level in the same part of the granary C123. It adds up to 15 letters to the left of lines 17-20. Both add only minor information about the parcels of land involved. (P. Heilporn, 2012)

div.note: This text has not been added to papyri.info yet.

item.p: [καὶ ὑπὸ κα]ινὴν δ[ι]ώ̣ρυγα, ed. There is space for the article, which fits nicely the traces at the start of the line on the new fragments; the same expression, probably about the same parcel, can be read in P.Mich. 9.556, 16 and has been restituted in its duplicate P.Mich. 9.555, 15; 39.

The restitution [δύο] is based on the available space in the lacunas here and at the start of line 19, and on the total amount of 4 arourai given in line 17, which is itself confirmed by the difference between 10 ar. 11/64 (line 7) and 6 ar. 11/64 (line 12)).
This line has been read with the help of lines 8-9; part of it is of course given exempli gratia.
